Q5738.reason: A mixed goods/services contract falls under the UCC unless the services predominate, so Connie wins under the UCC unless the service agreement was the predominant purpose.

Q5278.reason: Burglary requires intent to commit a felony at the moment of entry, and he entered the open party only to have a good time, forming the intent to steal later.

Q8324.reason: The agitated, drug-seeking presentation fits addiction, where chronic use downregulates post-synaptic dopamine receptors (reduced D2 availability).
